description: This script parses package index files for OpenWrt's native package manager, converting them into a JSON format suitable for downstream analysis. It handles both apk and opkg package formats, extracting package names and versions, and optionally outputs them in a list format for legacy compatibility.

methods.name: removesuffix(src, suffix)
methods.description: Removes a specified suffix from a string if it ends with that suffix; provides compatibility for Python versions earlier than 3.9.

methods.name: parse_args()
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to specify input file, architecture, format, and output options.

methods.name: dict parse_apk(text: str)
methods.description: Parses APK format JSON text to extract package names and versions, handling ABI suffixes.

methods.name: dict parse_opkg(text: str)
methods.description: Parses opkg list output text to extract package names and versions, handling ABI suffixes.

ctags.name: input
ctags.pattern: /^    input = sys.stdin if args.source == "-" else open(args.source, "r")$/

ctags.name: packages
ctags.pattern: /^    packages = parse_apk(text) if args.source_format == "apk" else parse_opkg(text)$/

fields.name: input = sys.stdin if args.source == "-" else open(args.source, "r")
packages = parse_apk(text) if args.source_format == "apk" else parse_opkg(text)
